title: Freya and the Vow
author: Quentin Lockridge
blurb: Casper Vasquez, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
